items.title: More Incidents Don't Necessarily Mean Less Reliability
items.blurb: One of the most common assumptions in engineering leadership is that a rising number of reported incidents signals declining system reliability.

items.title: Packer v1.16.0 brings verifiable provenance to machine images
items.blurb: Packer v1.16.0 adds native SLSA provenance generation and verification for machine images, along with new HCL2 features for provisioners and variables.

items.title: Rx.NET 7.0 Reduces Deployment Size by Splitting Windows UI Support
items.blurb: Rx.NET 7.0 has been released with a narrowly focused change aimed at reducing deployment size for Windows applications.
